An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores. |requirement = |startLocation = |prev = [[From the Echoes of Destruction]] |next = [[Legacy of the Lasting Night]] |rewards = }} {{Intro/Quest|Hidden Between the Waves}} == Summary == Passing through the mist, you encounter [[Aalto]] on patrol. After you recount your recent experience, he speculates that the blue figure you just saw might be [[The Shorekeeper]] from the [[Black Shores]]. However, the immediate priority is to upload the abnormal frequency to the [[Tethys System]] for analysis. Meanwhile, the Black Shores seem to be grappling with certain anomalies...
You hand over the data to the specialized robot at the Black Shores, which swiftly uploads it into the Tethys System. The merchant known as [[KU-Money]], perhaps mistaking you for one of their own, rewards you with a substantial sum of money. However, despite its extensive knowledge of the Black Shores, the robot knowns nothing of [[Hoda]]'s true identity.
Even [[Monica]], the chief administrator of the Black Shores, has never heard of the name Hoda. Right after your discussion, another quake shakes the Black Shores, echoing the disaster in the [[Port City of Guixu]]. To safeguard the Tethys System, Monica instructs you to inspect the [[Modulation Device]] in the [[Greenhouse]].
In the Greenhouse, you encounter two robots that recognize you as the lone Rover of Solaris. They speak of Blake Blooms as if you share a connection with them, but it appears that the Tethys System is somehow restraining them from revealing the truth of your identity...
{{tx}}
With the Anchor at the [[TD Observatory]] restored, a true frequency rises from the depths, bringing a voice to your mind. It reveals that your awakening in the [[Gorges of Spirits]] was no mere coincidence. Before [[Yangyang]] found you, a mysterious figure had been watching your every move...
With all restorations complete, you scarcely have a moment to res tbefore the enigmatic Bloom Bearer Hoda reappears, addressing you as the mentor she has been following. Shortly after, the Shorekeeper hersekf elerges, welcoming your return...
The Shorekeeper explains that during your absence, she and the Tethys System had taken over the running of the Black Shores. She confirms that it was indeed she who saved you, Yangyang, and [[Youhu]] in the Port City of Guixu. To address the threats posed by Hoda and the looming crisis in both the Black Shores and the Port City of Guixu, the Shorekeeper requests that you venture underground, to where the starry sky
